roleLabel: Pioneer of communication in Riacho He Hé
summary: Norma spent much of her life helping the stories of Riacho He Hé be heard.
paragraphs: Norma Edith Bedoya was one of the first social communicators of Riacho He Hé, in the province of Formosa. In the town they knew her as Norma de Vargas.
We want her story to help others find a voice of their own.
Her family is writing the full account: how she started, who she worked with, what she left done. It will be published here when it is finished. We would rather it arrive late and be true.

portrait.alt: Norma looks at the camera, smiling slightly. She is in her kitchen, wearing a black blouse with white dots. Behind her, a cupboard with glasses and a shelf of framed family photographs.

photos.alt: A close portrait of Norma. She wears a light-blue and blue striped shirt and looks at the camera with a contained smile.
Norma standing in the kitchen in a fuchsia blouse printed with flowers. Beside her, a vase with an open pink flower.
